children: STADLER AND CAPMETRO STRENGTHEN PARTNERSHIP WITH LONG-TERM SERVICE AGREEMENT FOR AUSTIN CAPMETRO RAIL FLEET
STARTING IN JANUARY 2027, STADLER WILL PROVIDE TECHNICAL ONSITE SUPPORT FOR 10 GTW DIESEL-POWERED ARTICULATED MULTIPLE UNIT VEHICLES CURRENTLY IN OPERATION ON CAPMETRO RAIL IN AUSTIN
CONTRACT INCLUDES A FIVE-YEAR BASE TERM FROM 2027 THROUGH 2032, WITH TWO ONE-YEAR OPTION PERIODS THAT COULD EXTEND PARTNERSHIP THROUGH 2034

title: Stadler And Capmetro Agree On Long-Term Service Agreement For Austin Capmetro Rail Fleet
